title: Verify that the page rich text renders headings, paragraphs, bullet lists, numbered lists, and inline links
description: Page Content is configured with one heading, one paragraph, a 3-item bullet list, a 3-item numbered sub-list, and one inline link. Verifies every rich-text element type renders on the public page.

steps.expected: Content saved and published; success toast shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page in English on the public site
steps.expected: Page loads with the content block visible

steps.action: Inspect the rendered content block
steps.expected: Heading, paragraph, 3 bulleted items, 3 numbered items, and the inline link all render as authored; the inline link is rendered as a clickable anchor pointing to https://www.qatarchamber.com

steps.expected: Alt text saved and published; success toast shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the Content Image visible

steps.action: Inspect the Content Image accessible name / alt attribute

title: Verify that all published content sections appear on the page in the configured order

steps.action: In Liferay CMS, configure Page Content (EN) with three sections in the order 'The Voice of Qatar's Private Sector', 'The Chamber's competences', 'Chamber Constituents:' and publish
steps.expected: Content published; success toast shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the first section visible

steps.action: Scroll from the top of the content block to the bottom and record the section order
steps.expected: All three sections render in the configured order — 'The Voice of Qatar's Private Sector', then 'The Chamber's competences', then 'Chamber Constituents:' — with no section missing or reordered

steps.action: Sign in to Liferay CMS as a user with the Site Content Editor role
steps.expected: Sign-in succeeds and the CMS dashboard loads

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record
steps.expected: Page record opens with Edit, Preview, Publish, and Unpublish controls all enabled

steps.action: Edit the Page Title (EN) to 'About Qatar Chamber', then use Preview, Publish, and Unpublish in turn
steps.expected: Each action completes and shows the Liferay success toast; no Access Denied message appears at any step

title: Verify that a Site Content Author can view and update assigned About Qatar Chamber page content
description: Signed in as Site Content Author with the About Qatar Chamber page assigned. Verifies view and update are permitted for this role.

steps.action: Sign in to Liferay CMS as a user with the Site Content Author role and the About Qatar Chamber page assigned
steps.expected: Sign-in succeeds

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record
steps.expected: Page record opens in editable mode

steps.action: Update Page Content (EN) and save
steps.expected: Change is saved and the Liferay success toast is shown; no Access Denied message appears

title: Verify that a Site Content Author cannot publish the About Qatar Chamber page
description: Signed in as Site Content Author, whose permissions cover view and update only. Verifies the publish action is not available to this role and cannot be forced.

steps.action: Sign in to Liferay CMS as a user with the Site Content Author role
steps.expected: Sign-in succeeds

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record and locate the publish control
steps.expected: The Publish control is absent or disabled for this role

steps.action: Attempt to publish the page
steps.expected: Publish does not occur; the page publication state is unchanged and 'Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action.' is shown (Arabic: تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.)

title: Verify that a user without the required permission is denied access to the About Qatar Chamber page record
description: Signed in as a CMS user holding neither Site Content Editor nor Site Content Author on this page. Verifies the exact bilingual Access Denied message and that no change is possible.

steps.action: Sign in to Liferay CMS as a user with no content role on the About Qatar Chamber page
steps.expected: Sign-in succeeds

steps.action: Attempt to open the About Qatar Chamber page record for editing
steps.expected: Access is refused and the message 'Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action.' is shown; the record does not open in editable mode

steps.expected: The same refusal is shown in Arabic as 'تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.'

title: Verify that publishing the About Qatar Chamber page makes the content visible on the website
description: Editor publishes the page with Page Title (EN) 'About Qatar Chamber' and one content section. Verifies the success toast fires and the content appears on the public site after cache refresh.

steps.action: Sign in to Liferay CMS as Site Content Editor and open the About Qatar Chamber page record
steps.expected: Page record opens with current values shown

steps.action: Set Page Title (EN) to 'About Qatar Chamber', Page Content (EN) to a section headed 'The Voice of Qatar's Private Sector', and click Publish
steps.expected: Page status changes to Published and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed

steps.action: Wait for the standard cache refresh and open the About Qatar Chamber page on the public site in English
steps.expected: Public page loads showing the title 'About Qatar Chamber' and the section 'The Voice of Qatar's Private Sector' exactly as authored

title: Verify that unpublishing the About Qatar Chamber page removes it from the website
description: Page is currently published. Verifies unpublishing removes public access while the record remains available in the CMS.

steps.action: Sign in as Site Content Editor and open the published About Qatar Chamber page record
steps.expected: Record opens with status Published

steps.action: Click Unpublish and wait for the standard cache refresh
steps.expected: Status changes to Unpublished and the success toast is shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page URL in a browser session with no CMS login
steps.expected: The public URL no longer serves the page content — the standard not-available/error page is shown instead of the About Qatar Chamber content

steps.action: Re-open the record in the CMS
steps.expected: The record and all its content are still present and editable in the CMS

title: Verify that draft About Qatar Chamber content is visible only in the CMS and not on the website

steps.expected: Content is saved with status Draft and the success toast is shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page on the public site in English and search the page text for 'DRAFT-ONLY-129392'
steps.expected: The public page does not contain the text 'DRAFT-ONLY-129392' anywhere and still shows the previously published content

steps.action: Re-open the record in the CMS
steps.expected: The CMS record shows the draft paragraph 'DRAFT-ONLY-129392'

title: Verify that Preview renders unpublished About Qatar Chamber content without publishing it

title: Verify that publishing the About Qatar Chamber page updates the page cache and writes an audit log entry

steps.expected: Publish succeeds and the success toast is shown

steps.action: Open the Liferay audit log and filter to the About Qatar Chamber page record
steps.expected: The audit log contains an entry for this publish action showing the About Qatar Chamber page, the acting Site Content Editor user, and a timestamp at or after the noted time
